دَثُورٌ : see مُتَدَثِّرٌ. ―
-b2- Applied to a man, (tropical:) Obscure; of no reputation: (S, A, K:) a great sleeper: (S, K:) slow: (K:) heavy; that scarcely moves from his place: (TA:) lazy: (Kr, M:) and in like manner ↓ دَثَارِىٌّ , lazy; quiet; that does not occupy himself with his affairs. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
